name: ras-commander
description: HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, and cloud-native GIS skills from RAS Commander and HMS Commander, with read-only RAS/HMS text MCP servers that only their dedicated subagents may call.

extra_roots.title: Extra project roots
extra_roots.description: Optional additional directories the read-only RAS/HMS text servers may read, besides the current project directory. Separate several paths with the OS path-list separator (';' on Windows, ':' on macOS/Linux) or enter a JSON array. Leave empty to allow only the project directory.
